## Market Size and Growth

The global artificial intelligence market reached 78 billion USD in 2025 and is projected to grow to 98.5 billion USD in 2026, according to IDC. Enterprise adoption of generative AI remains the primary growth driver: manufacturing, healthcare, and financial services together account for over 60% of total AI spending. North America leads regional demand with a 38% revenue share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest compound annual growth rate at 24.3%. Cloud-deployed AI platforms expanded fastest, with hyperscaler revenue from AI workloads rising 41% year over year. Vendor competition intensified as foundation-model providers pushed enterprise subscriptions, and system integrators reported record implementation backlogs. Analysts expect double-digit growth to persist through 2030 as regulated industries move from pilots to production deployments. Falling inference costs further strengthen the adoption outlook among mid-sized enterprises.
